add.a.pronunciation.dictionary.title: Add a pronunciation dictionary from file
add.a.pronunciation.dictionary.description: Add a pronunciation dictionary from file. Composio ELEVENLABS_ADD_A_PRONUNCIATION_DICTIONARY. Adds a new pronunciation dictionary from a lexicon file to improve speech synthesis accuracy. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

file.description: A lexicon file (typically .pls XML) containing pronunciation rules.

name.description: A descriptive name for the pronunciation dictionary.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the pronunciation dictionary and its purpose.

workspace_access.description: Access level for the pronunciation dictionary within the workspace (admin, editor, or viewer).

add.outbound.phone.number.title: Add outbound phone number
add.outbound.phone.number.description: Add outbound phone number. Composio ELEVENLABS_ADD_OUTBOUND_PHONE_NUMBER. Tool to import/register a Twilio phone number or SIP trunk into ElevenLabs Agents Platform. Use when you need to provision a phone number for outbound calls and ELEVENLABS_GET_AGENT_DETAILS returns empty phone_numbers. This does NOT purchase a new number; it imports an existing provider configuration into your ElevenLabs workspace.

sid.description: Twilio Account SID (required when provider is 'twilio')

label.description: Descriptive label for the phone number

token.description: Twilio Auth Token (required when provider is 'twilio')

phone_number.description: Phone number to import in E.164 format

region_config.description: Region configuration for Twilio phone number.

supports_inbound.description: Enable inbound call capability for this number

supports_outbound.description: Enable outbound call capability for this number

add.project.title: Add new project with attributes
add.project.description: Add new project with attributes. Composio ELEVENLABS_ADD_PROJECT. Use to create a new ElevenLabs project for text-to-speech synthesis (e.g., audiobooks); a project `name` is required by the API for creation, and content can be initialized using `from_url` or `from_document`. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

name.description: A unique name for the project, crucial for its identification and management.

title.description: Optional title for the project, distinct from `name` (e.g., for a book title).

author.description: Optional author for the project (e.g., for a book).

from_url.description: URL to extract content for initializing the project. Use instead of `from_document`.

isbn_number.description: Optional ISBN for the project, typically for audiobooks.

callback_url.description: Optional URL for a POST request with project conversion status updates.

from_document.description: Document file (e.g..txt.epub.pdf) to upload for initializing project content. Use instead of `from_url`.

default_model_id.description: Model ID for synthesis (e.g., 'eleven_multilingual_v2'; see GET /v1/models); uses default model if unspecified.

volume_normalization.description: Apply general volume normalization to audio output.

default_title_voice_id.description: Voice ID for titles (see GET /v1/voices); uses ElevenLabs default if unspecified.

acx_volume_normalization.description: Apply ACX (Audiobook Creation Exchange) volume normalization to audio output.

default_paragraph_voice_id.description: Voice ID for paragraphs (see GET /v1/voices); uses ElevenLabs default if unspecified.

pronunciation_dictionary_locators.description: List of pronunciation dictionary locators (format: 'dictionary_id@version_id') for custom pronunciations.

add.pronunciation.dictionary.from.rules.title: Add pronunciation dictionary from rules
add.pronunciation.dictionary.from.rules.description: Add pronunciation dictionary from rules. Composio ELEVENLABS_ADD_PRONUNCIATION_DICTIONARY_FROM_RULES. Tool to create a new pronunciation dictionary from provided rules for ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Use when you need to define custom pronunciations for specific words or phrases to improve speech accuracy. Supports both alias rules (simple text replacements) and phoneme rules (IPA phonetic notation).

name.description: The name of the pronunciation dictionary, used for identification only

rules.description: List of pronunciation rules defining text replacements. Each rule can be either an alias rule (simple text replacement) or a phoneme rule (phonetic pronunciation using IPA or other alphabet). Minimum 1 rule required.

description.description: A description of the pronunciation dictionary, used for identification only

workspace_access.description: Valid workspace access levels for pronunciation dictionaries.

add.rules.to.the.pronunciation.dictionar.title: Add rules to the pronunciation dictionary
add.rules.to.the.pronunciation.dictionar.description: Add rules to the pronunciation dictionary. Composio ELEVENLABS_ADD_RULES_TO_THE_PRONUNCIATION_DICTIONARY. Adds one or more custom pronunciation rules (alias or phoneme) to an existing pronunciation dictionary.

rules.description: List of pronunciation rule objects, each defining an 'alias' or 'phoneme' transformation for a specific string. - **Alias Rule**: Use `type: "alias"`, `string_to_replace`, and `alias` (replacement text). pronunciation_dictionary_id.description: Identifier of an existing pronunciation dictionary to which rules will be added.

add.sharing.voice.title: Add sharing voice
add.sharing.voice.description: Add sharing voice. Composio ELEVENLABS_ADD_SHARING_VOICE. Adds an existing, shareable voice to a specified user's ElevenLabs account library under a new custom name, requiring the user's public ID and the voice ID.

new_name.description: Name to assign the shared voice in the user's library, displayed on the ElevenLabs website.

voice_id.description: Unique identifier of the shared voice to be added.

public_user_id.description: Public user ID of the ElevenLabs user to whom the shared voice will be added.

add.voice.title: Add a voice
add.voice.description: Add a voice. Composio ELEVENLABS_ADD_VOICE. Adds a custom voice by uploading audio samples for voice cloning. Requires a name and at least one audio file. Recommended: 1-2 minutes of clear audio without background noise. Supported formats: mp3, wav, ogg. Returns a voice_id that can be used for text-to-speech after processing completes. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

name.description: Name for the new voice, used as its identifier in the platform.

files.description: List of audio files for voice cloning. Each file should be a Supported formats: mp3, wav, ogg. At least one file is required, and 1-2 minutes of clear audio without background noise is recommended.

labels.description: Optional stringified JSON object of key-value pairs for categorizing the voice. Example: {"accent": "American", "style": "narration"}

description.description: Optional description for the voice, detailing its characteristics or intended use cases.

remove_background_noise.description: If set to true, will remove background noise from voice samples using the audio isolation model. Only use if samples contain background noise; using it on clean audio can reduce quality.

attach.phone.number.to.agent.title: Attach phone number to agent
attach.phone.number.to.agent.description: Attach phone number to agent. Composio ELEVENLABS_ATTACH_PHONE_NUMBER_TO_AGENT. Tool to assign or unassign an existing imported phone number to an agent by updating the phone number's assigned agent. Use when you need to programmatically route inbound calls to a specific agent or change agent assignment for a phone number.

label.description: Descriptive label for the phone number

agent_id.description: ID of the agent to assign to the phone number. Set to null to unassign the phone number from any agent.

livekit_stack.description: Type of LiveKit stack to use

phone_number_id.description: The unique identifier of the phone number to update

calculate.convai.agent.llm.usage.title: Calculate ConvAI Agent LLM Usage
calculate.convai.agent.llm.usage.description: Calculate ConvAI Agent LLM Usage. Composio ELEVENLABS_CALCULATE_CONVAI_AGENT_LLM_USAGE. Tool to calculate expected number of LLM tokens needed for a conversational AI agent. Use when estimating costs for an agent based on knowledge base size, prompt length, and RAG configuration.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent

prompt_length.description: Length of the prompt in characters

number_of_pages.description: Pages of content in pdf documents OR urls in agent's Knowledge Base

calculate.convai.llm.usage.title: Calculate ConvAI LLM Usage
calculate.convai.llm.usage.description: Calculate ConvAI LLM Usage. Composio ELEVENLABS_CALCULATE_CONVAI_LLM_USAGE. Tool to calculate expected LLM usage costs for conversational AI agents. Use when you need to estimate pricing for different LLM models based on prompt length, knowledge base size, and RAG configuration.

prompt_length.description: Length of the prompt in characters.

number_of_pages.description: Pages of content in PDF documents or URLs in the agent's knowledge base.

cancel.convai.batch.call.title: Cancel Batch Call
cancel.convai.batch.call.description: Cancel Batch Call. Composio ELEVENLABS_CANCEL_CONVAI_BATCH_CALL. Tool to cancel a running batch call and set all recipients to cancelled status. Use when you need to stop an ongoing batch calling campaign.

batch_id.description: Unique identifier of the batch call to cancel

convert.chapter.title: Convert chapter to audio
convert.chapter.description: Convert chapter to audio. Composio ELEVENLABS_CONVERT_CHAPTER. Converts the textual content of a chapter, identified by `chapter_id` within a `project_id`, into audio format.

chapter_id.description: Identifier of the chapter to be converted.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project containing the chapter to be converted.

convert.project.title: Convert a project
convert.project.description: Convert a project. Composio ELEVENLABS_CONVERT_PROJECT. Converts an existing ElevenLabs Studio project, including all its chapters and using its configured settings and voices, into speech.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project to convert; find available IDs via the GET /v1/studio/projects endpoint.

create.a.previously.generated.voice.title: Create a previously generated voice
create.a.previously.generated.voice.description: Create a previously generated voice. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_A_PREVIOUSLY_GENERATED_VOICE. Finalizes the creation of a voice using its `generated_voice_id` from a previous generation step by assigning a name, description, and optional labels. Composio documents this route and the current ElevenLabs OpenAPI does not; live calls may 404. admin_url_prefix stays a query parameter.

labels.description: Key-value metadata to associate with the voice.

voice_name.description: Name for the newly created voice.

voice_description.description: Detailed description for the newly created voice, its characteristics, or intended use.

generated_voice_id.description: Identifier of a previously generated voice (e.g., from POST /v1/voice-generation/generate-voice), used to finalize its creation.

create.convai.agent.testing.title: Create Conversational AI Agent Test
create.convai.agent.testing.description: Create Conversational AI Agent Test. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_AGENT_TESTING. Tool to create a new ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent response test. Use when you need to set up automated testing for agent responses, tool calls, or conversation simulations. Supports three test types: 'llm' for response validation, 'tool_call' for tool execution verification, and 'simulation' for full conversation testing.

name.description: Name for the test case to identify it later

type.description: Type of test to create: 'llm' for response testing, 'tool' for tool execution testing, or 'simulation' for conversation simulation testing

chat_history.description: Array of messages representing the conversation history to test against. Each message must include role ('user' or 'agent'), time_in_call_secs (float), and optional message text content.

failure_examples.description: Examples of failed or incorrect agent responses for LLM tests

success_examples.description: Examples of successful agent responses for LLM tests

dynamic_variables.description: Key-value pairs of variables to be dynamically injected into the test context

success_condition.description: Required for 'llm' and 'simulation' types. Natural language description of what constitutes a successful agent response

simulation_scenario.description: Required for 'simulation' type. Natural language description of the scenario to simulate in the conversation

simulation_max_turns.description: For 'simulation' type tests: Maximum number of conversation turns to simulate

tool_call_parameters.description: For 'tool_call' type tests: Expected parameters for the tool that should be called by the agent

check_any_tool_matches.description: For 'tool_call' type tests: Whether to check if any tool matches the expected call pattern

from_conversation_metadata.description: Metadata from a previous conversation to use as context for this test

create.convai.knowledge.base.title: Add to ConvAI Knowledge Base
create.convai.knowledge.base.description: Add to ConvAI Knowledge Base. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE. Tool to add documentation to ElevenLabs Conversational AI knowledge base by uploading a file or referencing a webpage URL. Use when you need to provide reference materials or documentation that agents can access during conversations. Exactly one of 'file' or 'url' must be specified.

url.description: URL to a documentation webpage that the agent will have access to. Either 'file' or 'url' must be provided, but not both.

file.description: Documentation file to upload. Supported formats: PDF, TXT, DOC, DOCX. Either 'file' or 'url' must be provided, but not both.

name.description: Custom, human-readable name for the document in the knowledge base

agent_id.description: Specific agent ID to associate this knowledge base document with

create.convai.knowledge.base.file.title: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base File
create.convai.knowledge.base.file.description: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base File. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_FILE. Tool to create a knowledge base document from an uploaded file for ElevenLabs Conversational AI agents. Use when you need to provide documentation or reference material that agents can access during conversations. The uploaded file content will be indexed and made available to agents for answering user queries. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

file.description: Documentation file that the agent will have access to for interacting with users.

name.description: A custom, human-readable name for the document. If not provided, the filename will be used.

parent_folder_id.description: If set, the created document will be placed inside the given folder. Leave empty to place in root.

create.convai.knowledge.base.folder.title: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base Folder
create.convai.knowledge.base.folder.description: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base Folder. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_FOLDER. Tool to create a folder in the ElevenLabs ConvAI knowledge base for organizing documents. Use when you need to group related documents together in a hierarchical structure.

name.description: A custom, human-readable name for the folder

parent_folder_id.description: If set, the created folder will be placed inside the given parent folder. Leave empty to create at root level.

create.convai.knowledge.base.rag.index.title: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base RAG Index
create.convai.knowledge.base.rag.index.description: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base RAG Index. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_RAG_INDEX. Tool to compute or retrieve RAG indexes for multiple knowledge base documents in batch. Use when you need to enable semantic search on multiple knowledge base documents for conversational AI agents. This endpoint creates embeddings if missing or returns existing indexes, supporting up to 100 documents per request.

items.description: List of requested RAG indexes to create or retrieve (1-100 items)

create.convai.knowledge.base.text.title: Create Knowledge Base Text Document
create.convai.knowledge.base.text.description: Create Knowledge Base Text Document. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_TEXT. Tool to create a knowledge base document with text content in ElevenLabs Conversational AI. Use when you need to add text-based information to the knowledge base for agent reference.

name.description: A custom, human-readable name for the document.

text.description: Text content to be added to the knowledge base.

parent_folder_id.description: If set, the created document will be placed inside the given folder.

create.convai.knowledge.base.url.title: Create Knowledge Base URL Document
create.convai.knowledge.base.url.description: Create Knowledge Base URL Document. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_URL. Tool to create a knowledge base document by scraping the given webpage. Use when you need to add a web page as a knowledge source for a conversational AI agent.

url.description: URL to a page of documentation that the agent will have access to in order to interact with users

name.description: A custom, human-readable name for the document

parent_folder_id.description: If set, the created document or folder will be placed inside the given folder

create.convai.secret.title: Create ConvAI Workspace Secret
create.convai.secret.description: Create ConvAI Workspace Secret. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_SECRET. Tool to create a new secret for the ElevenLabs ConvAI workspace. Use when you need to securely store API keys, tokens, or other sensitive values that your conversational AI agents can reference.

name.description: Name identifier for the secret. Must be unique within the workspace.

type.description: Type of secret to create. Currently only 'new' is supported by the API.

value.description: The secret value to store securely in the workspace.

create.convai.tool.title: Create Conversational AI Tool
create.convai.tool.description: Create Conversational AI Tool. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVAI_TOOL. Tool to create a new conversational AI tool in ElevenLabs workspace. Use when adding custom tools for agents to execute during conversations. Supports webhook (external HTTP APIs), client (client-side execution), system (built-in), and MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool types.

name.description: Tool name. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only, no spaces, 1-64 characters)

params.description: System tool parameters (required for system tools)

tool_type.description: Type of tool to create: 'webhook' for HTTP endpoints, 'client' for client-side execution, 'system' for built-in tools, or 'mcp' for MCP integration

api_schema.description: API schema configuration (required for webhook tools). Should include endpoint URL and HTTP method details

parameters.description: Tool parameters schema (for client and MCP tools)

assignments.description: Tool assignments for routing to specific conversations

description.description: Tool description explaining what it does

mcp_server_id.description: MCP server ID (required for MCP tools)

mcp_tool_name.description: MCP tool name (required for MCP tools)

mcp_server_name.description: MCP server name (required for MCP tools)

tool_call_sound.description: Sound to play during tool call

expects_response.description: Whether the client tool expects a response (for client tools)

dynamic_variables.description: Dynamic variables configuration (for webhook and client tools)

mcp_tool_description.description: MCP tool description (required for MCP tools)

disable_interruptions.description: Whether to disable interruptions during tool execution

tool_error_handling_mode.description: How to handle tool execution errors.

create.conversational.agent.title: Create Conversational AI Agent
create.conversational.agent.description: Create Conversational AI Agent. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_CONVERSATIONAL_AGENT. Tool to create a new ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent with specified configuration. Use when you need to programmatically set up an agent with custom prompts, voice settings, and behavior. After creating the agent, you can chain other tools to attach phone numbers or configure additional settings.

name.description: Human-readable name for the agent

tags.description: List of tags to organize and categorize the agent

workflow.description: Workflow configuration defining conditional logic, tool execution modes, and conversation flow patterns for the agent

platform_settings.description: Platform-specific settings including evaluation criteria, widget configuration, data collection schemas, auth requirements, call limits, and privacy settings. For widget.variant, valid values are: 'tiny', 'compact', 'full', or 'expandable'.

conversation_config.description: Configuration object defining the agent's conversational behavior. Must include agent settings (prompt, llm, language, first_message), and can optionally include asr, tts, turn, conversation, and vad settings. Example: {'agent': {'prompt': {'prompt': 'You are a helpful assistant', 'llm': 'gpt-4o'}}}

create.music.plan.title: Generate Music Composition Plan
create.music.plan.description: Generate Music Composition Plan. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_MUSIC_PLAN. Tool to generate a music composition plan from a text prompt using ElevenLabs Music API. Use when you need to create a structured plan for music generation with defined styles, sections, and durations. The generated plan can be used as input for actual music generation or as a template for variations.

prompt.description: A simple text prompt to compose a plan from. Describe the musical style, mood, instruments, or other characteristics you want in the composition.

model_id.description: The model to use for the generation.

music_length_ms.description: The length of the composition plan to generate in milliseconds. Must be between 3000ms (3 seconds) and 600000ms (10 minutes). If not provided, the model will choose a length based on the prompt.

source_composition_plan.description: Optional source composition plan for generating variations.

create.similar.voices.title: Get similar library voices
create.similar.voices.description: Get similar library voices. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_SIMILAR_VOICES. Returns a list of shared voices similar to the provided audio sample. Use when you need to find voice matches based on audio characteristics. If neither similarity_threshold nor top_k is provided, default values will be applied. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

top_k.description: Number of most similar voices to return. If similarity_threshold is provided, fewer voices may be returned. Values range from 1 to 100. Default values will be applied if not specified.

audio_file.description: Audio file to find similar voices for. Supported formats: mp3, wav, ogg.

similarity_threshold.description: Threshold for voice similarity between provided sample and library voices. Values range from 0 to 2. The smaller the value, the more similar voices will be returned. Default values will be applied if not specified.

create.single.use.token.title: Create Single Use Token
create.single.use.token.description: Create Single Use Token. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_SINGLE_USE_TOKEN. Tool to generate a time-limited single-use token with embedded authentication for frontend clients. Use when you need secure, temporary access tokens for WebSocket connections or real-time services.

token_type.description: Type of single-use token to generate. Options: 'realtime_scribe' for real-time transcription, 'tts_websocket' for text-to-speech WebSocket connections.

create.workspace.webhook.title: Create Workspace Webhook
create.workspace.webhook.description: Create Workspace Webhook. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATE_WORKSPACE_WEBHOOK. Tool to create a new webhook for the workspace with specified authentication type. Use when you need to configure a webhook endpoint to receive notifications from ElevenLabs. The webhook_secret returned should be stored securely for verifying webhook authenticity.

settings.description: Webhook configuration settings including auth_type, name, and webhook_url

creates.audionative.enabled.project.title: Create an AudioNative enabled project
creates.audionative.enabled.project.description: Create an AudioNative enabled project. Composio ELEVENLABS_CREATES_AUDIONATIVE_ENABLED_PROJECT. Creates an ElevenLabs AudioNative project, generating an embeddable audio player from a provided content file using text-to-speech, allowing customization of player appearance, audio settings, and conversion options. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

file.description: Content file (e.g., TXT, HTML) to be converted into audio.

name.description: User-defined name for the AudioNative project.

image.description: URL for an image in the AudioNative player; a default or no image is used if omitted.

small.description: Set to `True` for a compact player; `False` (default) for standard size.

title.description: Title of the content, for display in the AudioNative player.

author.description: Author of the content, for display in the AudioNative player.

model_id.description: Identifier for the ElevenLabs TTS model. Allowed models for AudioNative: 'eleven_multilingual_v2', 'eleven_turbo_v2_5', 'eleven_turbo_v2', 'eleven_monolingual_v1', 'eleven_multilingual_v1'. A default is used if omitted.

voice_id.description: Identifier for the ElevenLabs voice; a default is used if omitted. See '/v1/voices' for available IDs.

text_color.description: Hex color code for player text (must start with '#', e.g., '#FFFFFF' for white, '#000000' for black).

auto_convert.description: If `True`, automatically converts content to audio after project creation; `False` (default).

sessionization.description: Interval in days for automatic audio reconversion; `0` (default) disables it (e.g., `1` daily, `7` weekly).

background_color.description: Hex color code for player background (must start with '#', e.g., '#000000' for black, '#FFFFFF' for white).

delete.chapter.title: Delete chapter from project
delete.chapter.description: Delete chapter from project. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CHAPTER. Irreversibly deletes a specific, existing chapter from an existing project, typically to remove unwanted or obsolete content.

chapter_id.description: Identifier of the chapter to be deleted. To find available `chapter_id`s for a project, you can query GET `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/studio/projects/{project_id}/chapters`.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project. To find available `project_id`s, you can query GET `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/studio/projects`.

delete.convai.agent.title: Delete Conversational AI Agent
delete.convai.agent.description: Delete Conversational AI Agent. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_AGENT. Tool to permanently delete a Conversational AI agent by its unique identifier. Use when you need to remove an agent configuration from the ElevenLabs workspace.

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent to delete. This is returned on agent creation.

delete.convai.agent.testing.title: Delete agent response test
delete.convai.agent.testing.description: Delete agent response test. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_AGENT_TESTING. Tool to delete an agent response test by ID. Use when you need to remove a test result or clean up test data.

test_id.description: The id of a chat response test. This is returned on test creation.

delete.convai.batch.calling.title: Delete batch call
delete.convai.batch.calling.description: Delete batch call. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_BATCH_CALLING. Tool to permanently delete a batch call and all associated recipient records. Conversations remain in history. Use when cleaning up completed or cancelled batch calls. The success status is 204 and the JSON envelope data is null.

batch_id.description: The unique identifier of the batch call to permanently delete. Format: btcal_<alphanumeric>

delete.convai.conversation.title: Delete conversation by ID
delete.convai.conversation.description: Delete conversation by ID. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_CONVERSATION. Tool to delete a particular Conversational AI conversation by ID. Use when you need to remove a conversation from the system for cleanup, compliance, or data management purposes.

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation to delete.

delete.convai.knowledge.base.title: Delete Knowledge Base Document or Folder
delete.convai.knowledge.base.description: Delete Knowledge Base Document or Folder. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE. Tool to delete a document or folder from the knowledge base. Use when you need to remove a knowledge base document or folder that is no longer needed.

force.description: If set to true, the document or folder will be deleted regardless of whether it is used by any agents and it will be removed from the dependent agents. For non-empty folders, this will also delete all child documents and folders.

documentation_id.description: The id of a document from the knowledge base. This is returned on document addition.

delete.convai.knowledge.base.rag.index.title: Delete ConvAI Knowledge Base RAG Index
delete.convai.knowledge.base.rag.index.description: Delete ConvAI Knowledge Base RAG Index. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_RAG_INDEX. Tool to delete RAG index for a knowledge base document. Use when you need to remove semantic search indexing from a document to free up resources or when the document no longer needs to be indexed.

rag_index_id.description: The id of RAG index of document from the knowledge base.

documentation_id.description: The id of a document from the knowledge base. This is returned on document addition.

delete.convai.secret.title: Delete workspace secret
delete.convai.secret.description: Delete workspace secret. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_SECRET. Tool to delete a workspace secret if it's not in use. Use when you need to remove unused secrets from the conversational AI workspace for security or cleanup purposes. The success status is 204 and the JSON envelope data is null.

secret_id.description: The unique identifier of the workspace secret to delete. This ID is returned when creating or listing secrets.

delete.convai.tool.title: Delete conversational AI tool
delete.convai.tool.description: Delete conversational AI tool. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_CONVAI_TOOL. Tool to delete a conversational AI tool from the workspace by ID. Use when you need to remove a tool configuration that is no longer needed or to clean up outdated tool definitions.

delete.dubbing.project.title: Delete a dubbing project
delete.dubbing.project.description: Delete a dubbing project. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_DUBBING_PROJECT. Permanently deletes a dubbing project by its ID; this action is irreversible and the project cannot be recovered.

dubbing_id.description: The unique identifier for the dubbing project to be deleted. This ID is typically obtained when the dubbing project is created or listed.

delete.history.item.title: Delete history item
delete.history.item.description: Delete history item. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_HISTORY_ITEM. Permanently deletes a specific history item (including its audio file and metadata) using its `history_item_id`; this operation is irreversible and should be used with caution.

history_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the history item to be deleted. This ID is obtainable by listing history items, for example, via the GET `/v1/history` endpoint.

delete.mcp.server.title: Delete MCP server
delete.mcp.server.description: Delete MCP server. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_MCP_SERVER. Tool to delete a specific MCP server configuration from the workspace. Use when you need to remove an MCP server that is no longer needed or to clean up outdated configurations.

mcp_server_id.description: ID of the MCP Server to delete from the workspace.

delete.phone.number.title: Delete phone number by id
delete.phone.number.description: Delete phone number by id. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_PHONE_NUMBER. Tool to delete an imported phone number from the ElevenLabs workspace by ID. Use when you need to remove a phone number configuration for cleanup or to avoid stale configurations in automated environments.

phone_number_id.description: The ID of the phone number to delete. This is returned on phone number creation.

delete.project.title: Delete project by id
delete.project.description: Delete project by id. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_PROJECT. Use to irreversibly delete a specific project by its `project_id`; the project must exist and be accessible, and this action cannot be undone.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project to delete. Obtain by listing projects (e.g., via GET /v1/studio/projects).

delete.sample.title: Delete voice sample
delete.sample.description: Delete voice sample. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_SAMPLE. Permanently deletes a specific voice sample for a given voice ID; this action is irreversible.

voice_id.description: Voice ID to be used, you can use https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices to list all the available voices.

sample_id.description: Sample ID to be used, you can use GET https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices/{voice_id} to list all the available samples for a voice.

delete.voice.title: Delete voice by id
delete.voice.description: Delete voice by id. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_VOICE. Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific custom voice using its `voice_id`; the voice must exist and the authenticated user must have permission to delete it.

voice_id.description: The unique identifier of the voice to be deleted.

delete.workspace.webhook.title: Delete workspace webhook
delete.workspace.webhook.description: Delete workspace webhook. Composio ELEVENLABS_DELETE_WORKSPACE_WEBHOOK. Tool to delete a specified workspace webhook by its ID. Use when you need to remove a webhook configuration that is no longer needed or to clean up webhook integrations.

webhook_id.description: The unique ID for the webhook

download.history.items.title: Download history items
download.history.items.description: Download history items. Composio ELEVENLABS_DOWNLOAD_HISTORY_ITEMS. Downloads audio clips from history by ID(s), returning a single file or a ZIP archive, with an optional output format (e.g., 'wav'); provides only audio content, no metadata. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

output_format.description: Optional. Specifies the desired output audio format. Accepts 'wav' to convert the audio to WAV format. If omitted, the audio is returned in its original synthesized format (e.g., mp3). This formatting applies to each audio file, even when multiple files are downloaded and returned as a ZIP archive.

history_item_ids.description: A list of unique string identifiers for the history items to be downloaded. These IDs can be obtained using the `GET /v1/history` endpoint.

dub.a.video.or.an.audio.file.title: Dub a video or an audio file
dub.a.video.or.an.audio.file.description: Dub a video or an audio file. Composio ELEVENLABS_DUB_A_VIDEO_OR_AN_AUDIO_FILE. Dub a video or audio file into a specified target language, requiring 'file' or 'source_url', 'target_lang', and 'csv_file' if 'mode' is 'manual'. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

file.description: Video or audio file to dub. Required if 'source_url' is not provided.

mode.description: Specifies dubbing mode: 'automatic' for AI-driven dubbing, or 'manual' using a .csv file for timestamped transcriptions. API defaults to 'automatic' if unspecified.

name.description: Name for the dubbing project.

csv_file.description: CSV file with guidance for 'manual' mode dubbing. Required if 'mode' is 'manual'.

end_time.description: End time (seconds) for the audio portion to dub. API defaults to audio end if unspecified.

watermark.description: Include a watermark in the dubbed audio.

source_url.description: URL of the video or audio file to dub. Required if 'file' is not provided.

start_time.description: Start time (seconds) for the audio portion to dub. API defaults to audio start if unspecified.

source_lang.description: Language of the original audio. Use 'auto' for automatic detection or provide a language code (e.g., 'en', 'es').

target_lang.description: Required target language code for dubbing (e.g., 'en', 'es').

num_speakers.description: Number of speakers in the audio. Use 0 for automatic detection; otherwise, model attempts to differentiate this many speakers.

dubbing_studio.description: Enable Dubbing Studio features for advanced editing capabilities, if available.

highest_resolution.description: Process dubbing at highest possible resolution; may increase processing time.

background_audio_file.description: Background audio track for 'manual' mode with a CSV file.

foreground_audio_file.description: Foreground audio track for 'manual' mode with a CSV file.

duplicate.convai.agent.title: Duplicate Conversational AI Agent
duplicate.convai.agent.description: Duplicate Conversational AI Agent. Composio ELEVENLABS_DUPLICATE_CONVAI_AGENT. Tool to create a new agent by duplicating an existing one. Use when you need to clone an agent's configuration. The new agent will inherit all settings from the original agent but can be given a new name.

name.description: A name to make the agent easier to find

name.description: Name for the voice model. This is a required field.

edit.voice.settings.title: Edit voice settings
edit.voice.settings.description: Edit voice settings. Composio ELEVENLABS_EDIT_VOICE_SETTINGS. Edits key voice settings (e.g., stability, similarity enhancement, style exaggeration, speaker boost) for an existing voice, affecting all future audio generated with that voice ID.

similarity_boost.description: Determines how closely the AI should adhere to the original voice when attempting to replicate it. Value between 0.0 and 1.0.

generate.a.random.voice.title: Generate a random voice

get.project.by.id.title: Get project by ID
get.project.by.id.description: Get project by ID. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_PROJECT_BY_ID. Use to retrieve all details for a specific project, including its chapters and their conversion statuses, by providing the project's unique ID.

project_id.description: Unique identifier for the project. To list all available projects and their IDs, you can use the endpoint that lists all projects (e.g., GET /v1/projects).

get.project.snapshots.title: Get project snapshots
get.project.snapshots.description: Get project snapshots. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_PROJECT_SNAPSHOTS. Retrieves all available snapshots (saved states or versions) for an existing project, enabling history tracking, version comparison, or accessing specific states for playback/processing, particularly in text-to-speech workflows.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project for which to retrieve snapshots. You can obtain project_ids by querying the GET /v1/studio/projects endpoint to list all available projects.

get.projects.title: Get projects
get.projects.description: Get projects. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_PROJECTS. Fetches a list of all projects and their details associated with the user's ElevenLabs account; this is a read-only operation.

get.pronunciation.dict.version.title: Get pronunciation dictionary version
get.pronunciation.dict.version.description: Get pronunciation dictionary version. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_PRONUNCIATION_DICT_VERSION. Downloads the Pronunciation Lexicon Specification (PLS) file for an existing version of a pronunciation dictionary from ElevenLabs, used to customize TTS pronunciation. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

version_id.description: The unique identifier of the specific version of the pronunciation dictionary.

dictionary_id.description: The unique identifier of the pronunciation dictionary.

get.pronunciation.dictionaries.title: Get pronunciation dictionaries
get.pronunciation.dictionaries.description: Get pronunciation dictionaries. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_PRONUNCIATION_DICTIONARIES. Retrieves a paginated list of pronunciation dictionaries, used to customize how specific words or phrases are pronounced by the text-to-speech (TTS) engine.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination, obtained from a previous response, to fetch the next set of pronunciation dictionaries. Omit or leave empty to retrieve the first page.

page_size.description: The number of pronunciation dictionaries to retrieve per page, with a maximum value of 100.

get.service.accounts.title: Get Service Accounts
get.service.accounts.description: Get Service Accounts. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_SERVICE_ACCOUNTS. Tool to list all service accounts in the workspace. Use when you need to view service accounts, their associated API keys, or manage workspace access.

get.shared.voices.title: Get shared voices
get.shared.voices.description: Get shared voices. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_SHARED_VOICES. Retrieves a paginated and filterable list of shared voices from the ElevenLabs Voice Library.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 0.

sort.description: Valid sort options for shared voices.

search.description: A search term to filter voices by name or description.

featured.description: Filters for voices that are marked as featured.

owner_id.description: Filters voices by the public ID of their owner.

page_size.description: Maximum number of shared voices per page (max 100).

use_cases.description: Filters voices by their intended use cases.

reader_app_enabled.description: Filters for voices that are enabled for the reader application.

get.sso.provider.admin.title: Get sso provider admin
get.sso.provider.admin.description: Get sso provider admin. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_SSO_PROVIDER_ADMIN. Retrieves the SSO provider configuration for a specified workspace, typically for review purposes, and will indicate if no configuration exists. Composio documents this route and the current ElevenLabs OpenAPI does not; live calls may 404. admin_url_prefix stays a query parameter.

workspace_id.description: The unique identifier of the workspace for which to retrieve the SSO provider configuration.

admin_url_prefix.description: The admin URL prefix for the workspace. This is typically 'v1' for the standard API version.

get.summaries.convai.agent.testing.summa.title: Get Agent Response Test Summaries
get.summaries.convai.agent.testing.summa.description: Get Agent Response Test Summaries. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_SUMMARIES_CONVAI_AGENT_TESTING_SUMMARIES. Tool to retrieve multiple agent response test summaries by their IDs. Use when you need to fetch summary information for multiple tests in a single request. Returns a dictionary mapping test IDs to their summary details including name, type, and timestamps.

test_ids.description: List of test IDs to fetch. No duplicates allowed.

get.transcript.for.dub.title: Get dubbing transcript by language
get.transcript.for.dub.description: Get dubbing transcript by language. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_TRANSCRIPT_FOR_DUB. Retrieves the textual transcript for a specified dubbing project and language, if one exists for that language in the project.

dubbing_id.description: The unique identifier for the dubbing project.

language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 language code for which to retrieve the transcript.

get.usage.character.stats.title: Get Usage Character Stats
get.usage.character.stats.description: Get Usage Character Stats. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_USAGE_CHARACTER_STATS. Tool to retrieve usage metrics for the current user or entire workspace. Returns time-series data with configurable aggregation intervals and breakdown types. Use when analyzing character usage patterns, tracking consumption by voice, user, or other dimensions over time.

end_unix.description: UTC Unix timestamp for the end of the usage window, in milliseconds. To include the last day of the window, the timestamp should be at 23:59:59 of that day.

start_unix.description: UTC Unix timestamp for the start of the usage window, in milliseconds. To include the first day of the window, the timestamp should be at 00:00:00 of that day.

aggregation_interval.description: Aggregation interval for usage data over time.

aggregation_bucket_size.description: Aggregation bucket size in seconds. Overrides the aggregation interval.

include_workspace_metrics.description: Whether or not to include the statistics of the entire workspace. Default is false.

get.user.subscription.info.title: Get user subscription info
get.user.subscription.info.description: Get user subscription info. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_USER_SUBSCRIPTION_INFO. Retrieves detailed subscription information for the currently authenticated ElevenLabs user.

get.voice.title: Get voice
get.voice.description: Get voice. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_VOICE. Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific, existing voice by its `voice_id`, optionally including its settings.

voice_id.description: Identifier of the voice. Use the `GET /v1/voices` endpoint to list available IDs.

with_settings.description: If true, the response will include detailed settings information for the voice.

get.voice.settings.title: Get voice settings
get.voice.settings.description: Get voice settings. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_VOICE_SETTINGS. Retrieves the stability, similarity, style, and speaker boost settings for a specific, existing ElevenLabs voice using its `voice_id`.

voice_id.description: Identifier of the voice for which to retrieve settings. A list of available voice IDs can be obtained from the /v1/voices endpoint.

get.voices.title: Get voices list
get.voices.description: Get voices list. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_VOICES. Retrieves a list of all available voices along with their detailed attributes and settings.

get.workspace.resource.title: Get workspace resource metadata
get.workspace.resource.description: Get workspace resource metadata. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_WORKSPACE_RESOURCE. Tool to get metadata of a workspace resource by ID and type. Use when you need access control information, creator details, or sharing options for a specific resource.

resource_id.description: The ID of the target resource.

resource_type.description: Resource type of the target resource.

get.workspace.webhooks.title: Get Workspace Webhooks
get.workspace.webhooks.description: Get Workspace Webhooks. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_WORKSPACE_WEBHOOKS. Tool to list all webhooks configured for the workspace. Use when you need to view existing webhook configurations or verify webhook settings.

include_usages.description: Whether to include active usages of the webhook, only usable by admins

healthcheck.title: Get user info
healthcheck.description: Get user info. Composio ELEVENLABS_GET_USER_INFO. Retrieves detailed information about the authenticated ElevenLabs user's account, including subscription, usage, API key, and status.

list.convai.agent.testing.title: List Conversational AI Agent Tests
list.convai.agent.testing.description: List Conversational AI Agent Tests. Composio ELEVENLABS_LIST_CONVAI_AGENT_TESTING. Tool to list all agent response tests with pagination support and optional search filtering. Use when you need to retrieve available tests, search tests by name, or paginate through large test collections.

cursor.description: Used for fetching next page. Cursor is returned in the response.

search.description: Search query to filter tests by name.

page_size.description: How many tests to return at maximum. Cannot exceed 100, defaults to 30.

list.dubs.title: List Dubs
list.dubs.description: List Dubs. Composio ELEVENLABS_LIST_DUBS. Tool to list dubbing projects you have access to. Use when you need to retrieve dubs, check their status, or paginate through available dubbing projects.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the next_cursor value from a previous response to fetch the next page.

order_by.description: The field to use for ordering results from this query.

page_size.description: Number of dubs to return per page. Cannot exceed 200, defaults to 100.

filter_by_creator.description: Filter for who created the dubbing projects.

list.phone.numbers.title: List Phone Numbers
list.phone.numbers.description: List Phone Numbers. Composio ELEVENLABS_LIST_PHONE_NUMBERS. Tool to list all imported phone numbers in the workspace. Use when you need to find available phone numbers, check their capabilities (inbound/outbound), or verify which agent is assigned to a number.

list.whatsapp.accounts.title: List WhatsApp Accounts
list.whatsapp.accounts.description: List WhatsApp Accounts. Composio ELEVENLABS_LIST_WHATSAPP_ACCOUNTS. Tool to list all WhatsApp accounts in the workspace. Use when you need to view available WhatsApp Business accounts, check which agents are assigned to WhatsApp numbers, or retrieve WhatsApp phone number details.

move.bulk.convai.knowledge.base.title: Move Bulk Knowledge Base Items
move.bulk.convai.knowledge.base.description: Move Bulk Knowledge Base Items. Composio ELEVENLABS_MOVE_BULK_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE. Tool to move multiple documents or folders from one folder to another in the knowledge base. Use when you need to reorganize multiple knowledge base items at once by moving them to a different folder or to the root level.

move_to.description: The folder ID to move the entities to. If not set, the entities will be moved to the root folder.

document_ids.description: The ids of documents or folders from the knowledge base to move. Must contain between 1 and 20 IDs.

move.convai.knowledge.base.title: Move ConvAI Knowledge Base Entity
move.convai.knowledge.base.description: Move ConvAI Knowledge Base Entity. Composio ELEVENLABS_MOVE_CONVAI_KNOWLEDGE_BASE. Tool to move a knowledge base document or folder to a different folder. Use when you need to reorganize your knowledge base by moving entities between folders or to the root level.

move_to.description: The folder to move the entities to. If not set, the entities will be moved to the root folder.

document_id.description: The id of a document from the knowledge base. This is returned on document addition.

outbound.call.title: Outbound call
outbound.call.description: Outbound call. Composio ELEVENLABS_OUTBOUND_CALL. Tool to place an outbound call via SIP trunk. Use when you need to initiate a voice call through an ElevenLabs agent after obtaining required IDs. Prerequisites: - The API key must have Conversational AI (convai) permissions enabled. For write operations like initiating calls, ensure your API key has the appropriate convai write scope. - A valid SIP trunk phone number must be configured for outbound calls in ElevenLabs. - The SIP trunk must have valid outbound configuration with proper address and credentials. - The agent must be properly configured in the Conversational AI platform.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to place the call with (retrieve via Agents API).

to_number.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format to call.

agent_phone_number_id.description: ID of the phone number to originate the call from (must support outbound calls).

conversation_initiation_client_data.description: Personalization and override payload for initiating a conversation.

redirect.to.mintlify.title: Get API documentation
redirect.to.mintlify.description: Get API documentation. Composio ELEVENLABS_REDIRECT_TO_MINTLIFY. Retrieves the content of the official ElevenLabs API documentation page hosted on Mintlify.

register.call.convai.twilio.title: Register Twilio Call for ConvAI Agent
register.call.convai.twilio.description: Register Twilio Call for ConvAI Agent. Composio ELEVENLABS_REGISTER_CALL_CONVAI_TWILIO. Tool to register a Twilio call and return TwiML to connect the call to an ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent. Use when you need to integrate ElevenLabs agents with your own Twilio infrastructure for inbound or outbound calls. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the Conversational AI agent to use for this call

direction.description: Direction of the call: 'inbound' for incoming calls or 'outbound' for outgoing calls

to_number.description: The phone number the call is directed to in E.164 format

from_number.description: The phone number the call is originating from in E.164 format

conversation_initiation_client_data.description: Optional client data for conversation initialization.

remove.rules.from.the.pronunciation.dict.title: Remove rules from pronunciation dictionary
remove.rules.from.the.pronunciation.dict.description: Remove rules from pronunciation dictionary. Composio ELEVENLABS_REMOVE_RULES_FROM_THE_PRONUNCIATION_DICTIONARY. Permanently removes exact-match pronunciation rules from a specified ElevenLabs pronunciation dictionary using a list of rule strings; non-matching rule strings are ignored and this action cannot add or modify rules.

rule_strings.description: A list of exact pronunciation rule strings to be removed from the dictionary (e.g., 'word -> wɜːd'). Non-matching strings will be ignored.

pronunciation_dictionary_id.description: Identifier of the pronunciation dictionary from which rules will be removed.

resubmit.convai.test.invocations.title: Resubmit Test Invocations
resubmit.convai.test.invocations.description: Resubmit Test Invocations. Composio ELEVENLABS_RESUBMIT_CONVAI_TEST_INVOCATIONS. Tool to resubmit specific test runs from a test invocation for a conversational AI agent. Use when you need to re-run failed tests or specific test cases from a previous test invocation.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to resubmit tests for

branch_id.description: ID of the branch to run the tests on. If not provided, the tests will be run on the agent default configuration.

test_run_ids.description: List of test run IDs to resubmit

test_invocation_id.description: The id of a test invocation. This is returned when tests are run.

agent_config_override.description: Configuration overrides to use for testing. If not provided, the agent's default configuration will be used.

retry.convai.batch.call.title: Retry Batch Call
retry.convai.batch.call.description: Retry Batch Call. Composio ELEVENLABS_RETRY_CONVAI_BATCH_CALL. Tool to retry a batch call, calling failed and no-response recipients again. Use when you need to retry unsuccessful calls from a previous batch calling campaign.

batch_id.description: Unique identifier of the batch call to retry. Retries failed and no-response recipients.

run.agent.tests.title: Run Agent Tests
run.agent.tests.description: Run Agent Tests. Composio ELEVENLABS_RUN_AGENT_TESTS. Tool to run selected tests on a conversational AI agent with optional configuration overrides. Use when you need to execute automated tests on an agent to validate responses, tool calls, or conversation flows. Supports running up to 200 tests in a single invocation with optional branch-specific or configuration override testing.

tests.description: List of tests to run on the agent. Must contain at least 1 test and at most 200 tests.

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent to run tests on. This is returned on agent creation.

branch_id.description: ID of the branch to run the tests on. If not provided, the tests will be run on the agent default configuration.

agent_config_override.description: Configuration overrides to use for testing.

set.agent.avatar.title: Set Agent Avatar
set.agent.avatar.description: Set Agent Avatar. Composio ELEVENLABS_SET_AGENT_AVATAR. Tool to set or update the avatar image for a Conversational AI agent displayed in the widget. Use when you need to customize the visual appearance of an agent by uploading a profile image. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads.

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent. This is returned on agent creation.

avatar_file.description: Image file to be used as the agent's avatar.

simulate.convai.agents.simulate.conversa.title: Simulate Conversational AI Agent Conversation
simulate.convai.agents.simulate.conversa.description: Simulate Conversational AI Agent Conversation. Composio ELEVENLABS_SIMULATE_CONVAI_AGENTS_SIMULATE_CONVERSATION. Tool to run a simulated conversation between an agent and an AI user. Use when testing agent behavior with specific scenarios or evaluating conversation flow. Returns full transcript with analysis including success metrics and conversation summary.

agent_id.description: The id of an agent. This is returned on agent creation.

new_turns_limit.description: Maximum number of new turns to generate in the conversation simulation

simulation_specification.description: A specification that will be used to simulate a conversation between an agent and an AI user

extra_evaluation_criteria.description: A list of evaluation criteria to test

speech.to.speech.title: Speech to speech
speech.to.speech.description: Speech to speech. Composio ELEVENLABS_SPEECH_TO_SPEECH. Converts an input audio file to speech using a specified voice; if a `model_id` is provided, it must support speech-to-speech conversion. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic audio generation (integer 0-4294967295). Same seed and parameters yield same audio.

audio.description: The audio file to be converted.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model. Must support speech-to-speech (where `can_do_voice_conversion` is true). Use /v1/models to list models.

voice_id.description: Identifier of the voice to be used. Available voices can be retrieved using the /v1/voices endpoint.

output_format.description: Output audio format. Supported options:  mp3_22050_32 (MP3 22.05kHz, 32kbps),  mp3_44100_32 (MP3 44.1kHz, 32kbps),  mp3_44100_64 (MP3 44.1kHz, 64kbps),  mp3_44100_96 (MP3 44.1kHz, 96kbps),  mp3_44100_128 (MP3 44.1kHz, 128kbps),  mp3_44100_192 (MP3 44.1kHz, 192kbps; Requires Creator tier or above),  pcm_16000 (PCM S16LE 16kHz),  pcm_22050 (PCM S16LE 22.05kHz),  pcm_24000 (PCM S16LE 24kHz),  pcm_441

voice_settings.description: JSON string defining voice settings, such as `stability` (float) and `similarity_boost` (float).

optimize_streaming_latency.description: Latency optimization. Higher values reduce latency but may lower quality. Options: 0 (no optimizations), 1 (normal), 2 (strong), 3 (max), 4 (max, text normalizer disabled; best latency, can mispronounce numbers/dates).

speech.to.speech.streaming.title: Speech to speech streaming
speech.to.speech.streaming.description: Speech to speech streaming. Composio ELEVENLABS_SPEECH_TO_SPEECH_STREAMING. Converts an input audio stream to a different voice output stream in real-time, using a specified speech-to-speech model. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

seed.description: An integer seed for deterministic audio generation (0-4294967295). Using the same seed with identical input parameters aims to produce the same audio output, aiding reproducibility.

audio.description: The input audio file (e.g..wav.mp3) to be converted.

model_id.description: Identifier of the speech-to-speech model (e.g., 'eleven_english_sts_v2'). Ensure the chosen model supports voice conversion. Available models can be fetched from the `/v1/models` endpoint.

voice_id.description: Identifier for the voice to be used. A list of available voices can be fetched from the `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices` endpoint.

output_format.description: Desired output audio stream format. Supported formats include: 'mp3_22050_32': MP3 22.05kHz 32kbps. 'mp3_44100_32': MP3 44.1kHz 32kbps. 'mp3_44100_64': MP3 44.1kHz 64kbps. 'mp3_44100_96': MP3 44.1kHz 96kbps. 'mp3_44100_128': MP3 44.1kHz 128kbps. 'mp3_44100_192': MP3 44.1kHz 192kbps (requires Creator tier or above). 'pcm_16000': PCM (S16LE) 16kHz. 'pcm_22050': PCM (S16LE) 22.05kHz. 'pcm_24000': PCM

voice_settings.description: A JSON string containing voice settings, such as stability and similarity_boost, to fine-tune the characteristics of the generated voice. Example: '{"stability": 0.5, "similarity_boost": 0.75}'. If not provided, the default voice settings for the selected voice will be used.

optimize_streaming_latency.description: Controls latency optimizations for streaming audio. Higher values offer lower latency at a potential cost to audio quality. Supported values: 0: Default mode (no latency optimizations). 1: Normal latency optimizations (provides about 50% of the latency improvement of option 3). 2: Strong latency optimizations (provides about 75% of the latency improvement of option 3). 3: Maximum latency optimizat

stream.audio.isolation.title: Stream audio isolation
stream.audio.isolation.description: Stream audio isolation. Composio ELEVENLABS_STREAM_AUDIO_ISOLATION. Tool to remove background noise from audio and stream the isolated result. Use when you need to clean up audio recordings by isolating vocals/speech and removing unwanted background noise. The audio file must be at least 4.6 seconds long. File inputs are sent in the JSON body. The declarative compiler does not encode multipart uploads. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

audio.description: The audio file from which vocals/speech will be isolated. Audio must be at least 4.6 seconds long.

file_format.description: The format of input audio. Use 'pcm_s16le_16' for 16-bit PCM at a 16kHz sample rate, single channel (mono), and little-endian byte order (lower latency). Use 'other' for all other encoded waveform formats.

stream.chapter.audio.title: Stream chapter audio
stream.chapter.audio.description: Stream chapter audio. Composio ELEVENLABS_STREAM_CHAPTER_AUDIO. Streams the audio for a specified chapter snapshot from an ElevenLabs project, optionally converting the output to MPEG format. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

chapter_id.description: Identifier of the chapter. To list available chapters for a specific project, use the GET /v1/studio/projects/{project_id}/chapters endpoint.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project. To find available project IDs, you can list all projects using the GET /v1/studio/projects endpoint.

convert_to_mpeg.description: If true, the output audio stream will be converted to MPEG format. If false, the audio will be streamed in its original format (likely PCM).

chapter_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the chapter snapshot (a specific version of the chapter). To list all available snapshots for a chapter, use the GET /v1/studio/projects/{project_id}/chapters/{chapter_id}/snapshots endpoint.

stream.convai.agents.simulate.conversati.title: Stream ConvAI agent simulate conversation
stream.convai.agents.simulate.conversati.description: Stream ConvAI agent simulate conversation. Composio ELEVENLABS_STREAM_CONVAI_AGENTS_SIMULATE_CONVERSATION. Tool to run a simulated conversation between an agent and a simulated user, streaming back the response. Response is streamed as partial lists of messages that should be concatenated, with a final message containing conversation analysis once complete.

agent_id.description: The ID of the conversational AI agent. This is returned on agent creation.

new_turns_limit.description: Maximum number of new turns to generate in the conversation simulation.

simulation_specification.description: Specification that defines how to simulate the conversation between the agent and a simulated user.

extra_evaluation_criteria.description: A list of additional evaluation criteria to test during the simulation.

stream.project.audio.title: Stream project audio
stream.project.audio.description: Stream project audio. Composio ELEVENLABS_STREAM_PROJECT_AUDIO. Streams audio from a specific project snapshot, optionally converting it to MPEG format.

convert_to_mpeg.description: If true, converts the output audio to MPEG format; otherwise, streams in its original or a default raw format.

streams.archive.with.project.audio.title: Archive project snapshot
streams.archive.with.project.audio.description: Archive project snapshot. Composio ELEVENLABS_STREAMS_ARCHIVE_WITH_PROJECT_AUDIO. Archives an existing project snapshot by its ID, creating a permanent, immutable, and typically irreversible copy of its state. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

project_id.description: The ID of the project whose snapshot is to be archived.

project_snapshot_id.description: The ID of the project snapshot to archive.

submit.batch.call.title: Submit Batch Call
submit.batch.call.description: Submit Batch Call. Composio ELEVENLABS_SUBMIT_BATCH_CALL. Tool to submit a batch call. Use when you need to initiate multiple calls (voice or WhatsApp) at once. Triggers real outbound calls immediately (if no scheduled_time_unix is set) or at the scheduled time — always confirm recipient list and call count with the user before executing.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent to use for the calls

recipients.description: List of recipient objects for batch calling

scheduled_time_unix.description: Unix timestamp to schedule the batch (omit or null to send immediately)

agent_phone_number_id.description: ID of the phone number to originate calls from

agent_whatsapp_business_account_id.description: ID of the WhatsApp Business Account to use

text.to.speech.title: Text to speech
text.to.speech.description: Text to speech. Composio ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH. Converts text to speech using a specified ElevenLabs voice and model, returning a downloadable audio file (use ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_STREAM for streaming instead). Keep `voice_id`, `model_id`, and `output_format` consistent across all chunks to avoid audible artifacts when concatenating. Some voice/model/format combinations require specific subscription tiers; test with a short sample before full runs. HTTP 429 on burst batches; respect `Retry-After` headers. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

seed.description: Integer seed for potentially deterministic audio generation. Repeatability with the same seed and parameters is aimed for but not guaranteed.

text.description: Input text for speech conversion. Max 10,000 characters for most models. Flash/Turbo v2 models: up to 30,000. Flash/Turbo v2.5 models: up to 40,000. For long-form content, use Studio.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model for synthesis. List available models via `/v1/models`; ensure chosen model's `can_do_text_to_speech` is true.

voice_id.description: Identifier of the voice for speech generation. Obtainable from the `/v1/voices` endpoint.

output_format.description: Output audio format. Supported formats include: - `mp3_22050_32`: 22.05kHz, 32kbps MP3. - `mp3_44100_32`: 44.1kHz, 32kbps MP3. - `mp3_44100_64`: 44.1kHz, 64kbps MP3. - `mp3_44100_96`: 44.1kHz, 96kbps MP3. - `mp3_44100_128`: 44.1kHz, 128kbps MP3. - `mp3_44100_192`: 44.1kHz, 192kbps MP3 (Creator tier+). - `pcm_16000`: 16kHz PCM (S16LE). - `pcm_22050`: 22.05kHz PCM (S16LE). - `pcm_24000`: 24kHz PCM (

voice_settings.description: Voice settings for controlling speech generation characteristics.

optimize_streaming_latency.description: Controls latency optimizations for streaming. Higher values reduce latency, potentially affecting quality. 0: No optimizations. 1: Normal (approx. 50% of max improvement vs option 3). 2: Strong (approx. 75% of max improvement vs option 3). 3: Maximum. 4: Maximum with text normalizer disabled (affects number/date pronunciation, best latency). NOTE: Not supported with model 'eleven_v3'. If using ele

pronunciation_dictionary_locators.description: List of up to 3 pronunciation dictionary locators, applied sequentially. Each dictionary must contain `pronunciation_dictionary_id` and `version_id`.

text.to.speech.stream.title: Text to speech stream
text.to.speech.stream.description: Text to speech stream. Composio ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_STREAM. Converts text to a spoken audio stream (no saved file or history entry); use the non-streaming text-to-speech tool when a persistent audio URL is needed. Allows latency optimization, specific output formats (some tier-dependent), and custom pronunciations; ensure the chosen model supports text-to-speech and text is preferably under 5000 characters. Keep voice_id, model_id, and output_format consistent across multi-chunk sessions to avoid audio artifacts. The provider response is not JSON. Fixture replay uses a JSON envelope at the official method and path.

seed.description: If specified, the system will attempt to sample deterministically, meaning that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should ideally return the same audio result. However, complete determinism is not guaranteed.

text.description: The text that will be converted into speech. It is recommended to keep the text length under 5000 characters, as longer texts might face limitations.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model to be used for text-to-speech conversion. Available models can be listed using the `GET /v1/models` endpoint. Ensure the chosen model supports text-to-speech by verifying its `can_do_text_to_speech` property. Voice and account compatibility with specific models (e.g., eleven_turbo_v2, eleven_multilingual_v2) may vary; validate by testing a short clip (~200 characters) befor

voice_id.description: Identifier of the voice to be used for speech generation. A list of available voice IDs can be retrieved from the `GET /v1/voices` endpoint.

output_format.description: Specifies the desired output format for the generated audio stream. Supported MP3 formats: - mp3_22050_32: MP3, 22.05kHz, 32kbps. - mp3_44100_32: MP3, 44.1kHz, 32kbps. - mp3_44100_64: MP3, 44.1kHz, 64kbps. - mp3_44100_96: MP3, 44.1kHz, 96kbps. - mp3_44100_128: MP3, 44.1kHz, 128kbps. - mp3_44100_192: MP3, 44.1kHz, 192kbps (Creator tier or above required). Supported PCM formats (S16LE): - pcm_16000:

optimize_streaming_latency.description: Controls latency optimization for the streaming audio. Higher values prioritize lower latency, potentially at the cost of audio quality. Possible values: - 0: Default mode (no latency optimizations). - 1: Normal latency optimizations (reduces latency by approximately 50% of option 3's improvement). - 2: Strong latency optimizations (reduces latency by approximately 75% of option 3's improvement).

pronunciation_dictionary_locators.description: A list of pronunciation dictionary locators to be applied to the text. Each locator should be a dictionary containing 'pronunciation_dictionary_id' (string) and 'version_id' (string). Dictionaries are applied in the provided order. A maximum of 3 locators can be used per request.
